# Backspace Fork 1.16.0

## Fixes

- **Dependency security:** updates minimatch to 11.0.3 and modern glob consumers
  to 14.0.3, fixing CVE-2026-118764 and CVE-2026-118773. OSV remains enforcing;
  no new vulnerability exceptions are added.
- **Desktop packaging compatibility:** preserves the legacy callback and sync
  glob APIs, native-file unpacking and include/exclude filters while using the
  fixed matcher. Explicit dotfiles, brace alternatives and unmatched patterns
  keep their expected behavior without disabling upstream amplification limits.
- **Scanner maintenance:** replaces the deprecated OSV `--output` flag with
  `--output-file` without changing scan coverage or SARIF publication.

The server-only bounded diagnostics and removal of desktop minimum-version
lockouts from 1.15.9 remain included and unchanged.

## Operations

- No new database migration. Preserve existing database, uploads, environment
  secrets and instance identity. The existing build-time deepmerge exception
  remains documented and time-limited; these fixes add no waiver.
- When upgrading from 1.15.8 or earlier, synchronize the Compose configuration
  and recreate the relevant containers for the existing log-rotation limits to
  take effect. Schedule any LiveKit recreation around active calls.
